title: Fake bank fraud team (scam)
note: Scripted role-play written by the team. Not a real call.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hi Maya, this is Daniel from the fraud department at your bank.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We've flagged two suspicious transactions on your account this morning.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Oh no, what kind of transactions?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Please don't hang up, and don't tell anyone at the branch. We believe an employee may be involved.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Okay... what do I need to do?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: To protect your savings, we need you to transfer them to a secure holding account right now.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: I'll hang up and call the number on the back of my card.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: No, no. If you hang up, the transfer can't be stopped. Stay with me.
